description: Discover a more valuable goal beyond the current framing of a project, idea, conversation, or everyday activity. Use for “be ambitious,” “think bigger,” “what could this become,” or requests for a step change in direction. No repository or concrete task required. Unlike deepen-task, which strengthens the current task, this skill reconsiders what to pursue. Not for routine execution or simply doing a task more rigorously.
